name: project-bootstrap
description: Makes Kimi Code orient itself and specialise to a repo when resuming work, or to a new idea when starting a project. Includes monetization, go-to-market, and pricing skills for devtools.

interface.shortDescription: Self-orienting sessions: resume a repo or start a new project
interface.longDescription: Project Bootstrap classifies the current directory at session start and offers the right next step. It adds slash commands to resume existing projects, scaffold new ones, and wrap up sessions, plus skills for monetization, go-to-market, and pricing planning.
